c74object.name: lp.qvvvl~
c74object.digest: Generate variable-colour noise with a limiter
c74object.description: lp.qvvvl~ generates variable-colour noise with a limiter. Like lp.qvvv~, plus a look-ahead limiter (on by default) after the range handling, so the output stays within +/- 1 without clipping.

method.name: clip
method.digest: Clip output to the signal range
method.description: Clip output to the signal range.

method.name: float
method.description: In the left inlet: Hurst factor. In the 2nd inlet: NN factor.

method.name: int
method.description: In the left inlet: Hurst factor. In the 3rd inlet: Limiter on/off, default on.

method.name: limit
method.digest: Turn the look-ahead limiter on (1) or off (0)
method.description: Turn the look-ahead limiter on (1) or off (0).

method.name: reflect
method.digest: Reflect output back into the signal range
method.description: Reflect output back into the signal range.

method.name: stet
method.digest: Leave the output range as it is (default)
method.description: Leave the output range as it is (default).

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).

method.name: wrap
method.digest: Wrap output into the signal range
method.description: Wrap output into the signal range.
